title: Rotate Image
summary: Turn the square image 90 degrees clockwise by changing its cells in place.

contractDetails.constraints: Square matrix of side 1–20, with integer entries in [−1000,1000].
contractDetails.callable: `rotate` mutates the supplied matrix and returns no value outside R. The runner reads the changed matrix. R returns the changed list of rows.

statement: Turn the square image 90 degrees clockwise by changing its cells in place. Use the existing matrix storage. The output shows the changed matrix.

examples.explanation: The left column moves to the top row in reverse order.
The top-center pixel moves to the center-right.

constraints: Square matrix of side 1–20, with integer entries in [−1000,1000].
hints: Conceptual: The top row becomes the right column.
Directional: Swapping across the main diagonal exchanges rows and columns.
Implementation: Transpose the matrix, then reverse each row in place.
complexityAnalysis: O(n²) time and O(1) extra space in a mutable matrix representation.
